A1_TanStack_Query_plus_Zustand.description: frontend.md proposal - TanStack Query for server state, Zustand for client state
pros: TanStack Query industry standard for server state

A2_Redux_Toolkit.description: Single store for all state (server + client) using RTK Query
pros: RTK Query handles server state well
cons: Overkill for client state (auth, cart, UI)
Would require removing Zustand and rewriting authStore

A3_Zustand_plus_React_Query.description: Zustand for client state, React Query (v4/v5, same as TanStack Query) for server state
pros: Same as A1 (React Query = TanStack Query v4+)
cons: Naming confusion (React Query rebranded to TanStack Query)

A4_Context_plus_hooks.description: React Context for global state, custom hooks for data fetching
cons: No caching, invalidation, deduping for server state
Performance issues with frequent updates (Context re-renders all consumers)
Cart sync with Redis (Q-014) would be manual

recommendation.decision: A1 / A3 - TanStack Query for server state + Zustand for client state
rationale: frontend.md explicitly documents this as the decision for Q-023
Zustand 5.0.16 already installed and used in authStore
authStore already uses zustand persist middleware for localStorage
Clear architectural separation: server state (API data, caching) vs client state (auth, cart, UI)
Matches React Router v6+ for URL state
Test failures are test setup issues, not architecture issues
required_actions: Configure QueryClient with defaults (staleTime, retry, etc.)
Fix authStore test: await act() or waitFor for persist flush, or mock persist storage
Fix App.test.tsx: wrap renderWithProvider with MemoryRouter
Generate API client from OpenAPI spec (already exists at docs/api/openapi.yaml)
